verdict.rationale:
Square documents a dedicated Subscriptions API (square-docs-23), confirming recurring billing support, but the evidence pack gives no detail on plan configuration, trial periods, upgrade/downgrade flows, or proration logic. An old community comment (square-comm-1) also shows subscriptions were historically seen as a gap, though this predates the current API's existence.
Missing for 10: documented support for trials, plan upgrades/downgrades, and proration calculations; independent/hands-on confirmation these work as expected.
